title: Cotangent dimensions and residue finiteness for the regular p-root quotient
statement: Let $k$ be a field of prime characteristic $p$, $A$ a Noetherian local $k$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] geometrically regular over $k$ [def-weil-pbc-g-ring], $n\ge 0$, and $a:\operatorname{Fin}n\to k$ with the differentials $\mathrm da_i$ linearly independent over $k$ in $\Omega_{k/\mathbf F_p}$ [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials]. Give $A$ its composite $\mathbf F_p$-algebra structure. Put $B=A[X_i]/(X_i^p-a_i)$, the actual quotient [lem-weil-pbc-pth-root-algebra-local]. For every local-ring structure on $B$ for which $A\to B$ is local, put $K=A/\mathfrak m_A$ and $L=B/\mathfrak m_B$, with the induced field map $K\to L$. Then $L$ is finite-dimensional over $K$, and $\dim_L(L\otimes_K(\mathfrak m_A/\mathfrak m_A^2))=\dim_L(\mathfrak m_B/\mathfrak m_B^2)$. The cotangent spaces carry their residue field scalar actions, and $\dim$ denotes Module.finrank.

proof.text: Identify the actual p-root quotient B with A tensor_k F for a finite purely inseparable field F in universe max u v. Extend a finite k-basis of F to A and transport it to B. This makes B finite and free over A; locality implies it is nontrivial, so the free scalar action is faithful. Finiteness gives a finite residue extension under the assumed local coefficient map.

Geometric regularity makes F tensor_k A regular; swap factors and transport through the quotient equivalence to make B regular. Apply geometric regularity also to ULift k, a finite purely inseparable trivial extension, and transport the tensor unit equivalence to make A regular. Both are local, so both are regular local.

Finite algebras are integral and the free faithful scalar action makes the map injective. The existing integral-extension dimension theorem gives dim B=dim A. The regular-local cotangent criterion identifies each dimension with the residue cotangent finrank. Module.finrank_baseChange removes scalar extension on the left, and injectivity of natural-number casts proves the displayed equality.

theorem pthRoot_cotangent_dimension
    (k : Type u) (A : Type v) [Field k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP k p]
    (hA : IsGeometricallyRegular k A) (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → k) :
    letI := ZMod.algebra k p
    letI := ((algebraMap k A).comp (algebraMap (ZMod p) k)).toAlgebra
    let B := pthRootAlgebra p n A (fun i ↦ algebraMap k A (a i))
    ∀ [IsLocalRing B] [IsLocalHom (algebraMap A B)],
    LinearIndependent k (fun i ↦ KaehlerDifferential.D (ZMod p) k (a i)) →
    let K := IsLocalRing.ResidueField A
    let L := IsLocalRing.ResidueField B
    Module.Finite K L ∧
      Module.finrank L (L ⊗[K] IsLocalRing.CotangentSpace A) =
        Module.finrank L (IsLocalRing.CotangentSpace B)
